weather_report:
The morning in Boston unfolds under a heavy grey blanket, with clouds wrapping the skyline in an intimate embrace. As the day progresses, rain showers tease the horizon, whispering promises of a proper drenching. The chance of thunderstorms adds a lively edge to the damp air, reminding us that nature remains unpredictable yet captivating. The damp atmosphere lingers, hinting at fog that will weave through the streets, blurring the edges of familiar sights. With temperatures gently resting around 71 degrees, the warmth provides a cozy backdrop for the impending rain, while breezes from the southeast carry the scent of the approaching storms.

Considering these conditions, the day calls for practicality in your attire. A light rain jacket or an umbrella would serve you well, complementing a comfortable pair of shoes that won’t mind the occasional puddle. As the world becomes shrouded in fog, perhaps today is the perfect moment for a quiet walk through the rain-slicked streets of Boston or a visit to one of the city’s many inviting cafés, where the rhythmic tapping of raindrops creates a soothing soundtrack. A leisurely afternoon spent delving into a good book or enjoying quiet conversation feels just right as nature performs her symphony outside—an invitation to reconnect with simple pleasures on a day of beautiful melancholy.
